notes: v2.9.61: live current-bar Cha detection now uses only information available at that moment. For every candidate stock, after a valid Young rise PUMA watches the active 5-minute bar, requires price to enter the deep Cha zone above the basis open and at or below the 50% Young-rise line, waits a short 20-second noise filter, and compares the active bar volume per second with the completed Young-section volume pace. If volume pace has slowed, the current bar can trigger the first-Cha entry immediately without waiting for candle close or future bars. Basis-open stop, 08:00 NXT live trading, +4% 25% partial profit, trend tracking and 15:00 final liquidation remain unchanged.
